tools.name: get_provision
tools.description: Use this to read or quote an EU legislative provision, such as PSD2 Article 97 or RTS-SCA Article 5. Returns the source text of an article, annex or recital as markdown, with its cite anchor, provenance and text state; a long provision paginates by structural block. version_id is optional, and a pin

tools.name: get_instrument
tools.description: Use this to check an EU instrument's recorded legal status, source version, dates and amendments, including whether a held PSR or PSD3 text is a proposal, a Council compromise text or the act published in the Official Journal. Metadata, dates, lifecycle and application events, and curated relationsh

tools.name: list_instruments
tools.description: Use this to discover which EU instruments are held before a coverage question, or find their registry ids and legal status. Paginated, filterable by status, category, core/supplementary, and by whether an instrument was in force on a given date. For corpus-coverage questions, filter by category here

tools.name: get_source_notes
tools.description: Use this to read the original legislative footnotes and source-note bodies for a held instrument, including preamble and annex notes. tools.name: list_provisions
tools.description: Use this to browse an EU instrument's article, annex or recital index, or enumerate its topic-tagged provisions for a coverage question. Metadata only: each item carries the exact locator get_provision accepts. Articles and annexes by default; pass kind=recital for recitals.

tools.name: search_legislation
tools.description: Use this to find EU legislative provisions on payment-services questions: strong customer authentication (SCA), dynamic linking, open banking, safeguarding and payment liability. For exact wording use get_provision; for defined-term wording use get_defined_term. Full-text search across articles, ann

tools.name: resolve_citation
tools.description: Use this to resolve a written EU legal citation, such as Article 97(1) PSD2, into an instrument and provision locator. For a topic rather than a citation, use search_legislation. tools.name: search_defined_terms
tools.description: Use this to find which EU instruments define a legal term, such as payment transaction or payment account, and where their definitions differ. tools.name: get_defined_term
tools.description: Use this to read and compare the held legislative definitions of a term, such as payment transaction in PSD2 and PSR. tools.name: compare_versions
tools.description: Use this to compare an article between the Commission proposal and the Council compromise text of PSR or PSD3, within the same instrument. Serves the word-level comparison the build published: a pair is servable if and only if a diff artefact exists for it — the PSR and PSD3 proposal↔compromise pair

tools.name: list_version_changes
tools.description: Use this to browse which articles changed between the Commission proposal and the Council compromise text of PSR or PSD3; no comparison with a text published in the Official Journal is held. For one article's wording changes use compare_versions. Across those two texts, lists every aligned article w

tools.name: show_changes
tools.description: Shows the reader what changed: presents a comparison or a change inventory to the reader as an interactive card, this service's intended way of showing what changed between the two texts of a served pair. With article, the card is that article's word-level comparison, side by side with every change

tools.name: search
tools.description: Use this to find EU payments legislation on topics such as SCA, open banking and safeguarding in the held PSD2, RTS-SCA, PSD3/PSR and related instruments. tools.description: Use this to open and cite an EU legislative provision found by search. Simple retrieval of one provision's text by its cite anchor id (e.g. "psd-2 Art 97"), with citation metadata. findings.detail: Description of "get_defined_term" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_provision" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
